description.zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain name of the website service.

> The domain name must have website forwarding rules configured. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The resource group ID to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs in Resource Management. The default value is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

description.zh:
频率控制防护（CC防护）的防护模式。取值：
- **default**：正常
- **gf_under_attack**：攻击紧急
- **gf_sos_verify**：严格
- **gf_sos_enhance**：超级严格
description.en:
The defense mode for Frequency Control (HTTP flood protection). Valid values:

- **default**: Normal

- **gf\_under\_attack**: Attack Emergency

- **gf\_sos\_verify**: Strict

- **gf\_sos\_enhance**: Super Strict

title.zh: 设置网站CC防护的防护模式

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo config-web-cc-template --resource-group-id default --domain www.aliyun.com --template default --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo ConfigWebCCTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceGroupId default --Domain 'www.aliyun.com' --Template default
